title: Model Pin Composer & Performance Snapshot Browser
creator: Ava Chen
description: Make it easy for platform and product teams to select, pin, and publish performance profiles for model versions from a single composable UI. The feature combines a 'Pin Composer' for binding routes/environments to a model version and a 'Performance Snapshot Browser' for comparing published perf profiles (latency, throughput, cost, regressions) before pinning or rolling out. Goal: reduce time-to-pin and prevent regressions from accidental version switches.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open a Pin Composer from a model version row and select target routes / environments with a single flow
Performance Snapshot Browser shows last 3 published profiles per model-version, with key metrics, sample prompt set results, and a changelog
A 2-step publish-and-pin flow: confirm profile to publish (optional), choose pin scope (route/stage/global), preview impact, and commit
UI surfaces warnings for profile regressions > 10% latency or >5% quality drop versus current pinned version
Audit log entry created for every pin/publish action with user, timestamp, and profile diff
RBAC: only users with 'pin:write' can commit a pin; viewers can preview and propose but not commit
proposal_summary: Introduce two coordinated console pieces: (1) Pin Composer — a modal side-sheet that composes pin bindings and rollout policy (immediate, canary %, staged), with an inline Performance Snapshot preview; (2) Performance Snapshot Browser — a horizontally scrollable catalog accessible from model version details, showing published profiles as cards (metrics, token-cost estimate, sample outputs, confidence bands) and a 'compare' checkbox to open a diff view. The Pin Composer can open the Browser in a nested panel to let users choose a snapshot to publish and pin in the same flow.
ux_flow_steps: User navigates to Models > <model> > Versions and clicks 'Pin' on a version row
Pin Composer slides in: select scope (route/environment/all), select rollout type (immediate/canary/staged), toggle 'publish profile'
If 'publish profile' selected -> open Performance Snapshot Browser modal to pick or create a profile snapshot
User selects snapshot(s) to compare; Browser shows side-by-side metrics, sample prompt outputs, and diff highlights
Composer shows preview of traffic split / estimated cost delta; user confirms -> system validates SLO constraints
On success, pin commit recorded, profile published (if chosen), and console shows toast + link to audit log
design_feedback: Design review 2026-02-18: prefer side-sheet composer vs full-page to keep context with version list
Accessibility review 2026-02-24: ensure color contrast on regression badges and keyboard support for snapshot compare
PM feedback 2026-02-28: add 'dry-run' preview that simulates cost and request distribution for canary flows
engineering_notes: Backend APIs required: POST /pins (scope, version, policy, profile_id), GET /profiles?version=, GET /profiles/:id/diff?against=
Need audit-log hook with immutable record entry and link to profile snapshot storage
Permissions check: use existing RBAC service; front-end should hide commit button if pin:write missing
Estimate work for backend + QA: ENG: 5 sprint-days; Frontend: 6 sprint-days; Add telemetry events for pin.publish, pin.commit, profile.compare
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Beta behind feature-flag for accounts with Dedicated capacity (2 weeks)
Phase 2: Gradual rollout to 10% of hosted accounts and gather metrics (4 weeks)
Phase 3: Default enable for all accounts after regressions <1% for 30 days
qa_plan: E2E test flows: publish-only, pin-only, publish+pin, canary rollout steps
Regression tests: ensure existing pin endpoints continue to accept legacy payloads
Security tests: RBAC negative cases and audit log immutability
Performance tests: ensure snapshot compare queries return <200ms for catalogs of 500 snapshots
